How hot should you drink your coffee? 



Tim Cross

Senior science writer



 I’m writing this with a delicious, carcinogenic cup of tea steaming on my desk. It is carcinogenic at the moment because it’s freshly made and the water is hot. And according to a much-covered study published on September 8th, hot drinks are bad for your throat.

🧠 Crypto News Brief: Macro still owns the tape — bitcoin sits near $77K with a Fed hike all but priced in. Underneath it, Washington moves on crypto tax rules while security failures and political money take the headlines. 🏛️ House Tax Panel Sets First-Ever Vote on Crypto Tax Rules The House Ways and Means Committee has scheduled a September 16 markup on a package of digital asset tax bills — the first time crypto tax legislation has reached a formal committee vote. H.R. 9175 would let miners and stakers defer income on newly created tokens until they are sold, while H.R. 9172 would extend stock-style wash-sale rules to digital assets. A favourable vote sends the package to the full House floor.
